personas.name: Chloe Martin
personas.bio: Food blogger with 20k Instagram followers who wants one free link page for her recipes and shop; uses her phone for everything.

personas.name: Dev Patel
personas.bio: Indie musician who wants a clean page linking his Spotify, YouTube and tour dates; zero budget.

personas.name: Isabella Costa
personas.bio: Small Etsy seller who wants her link page to look on-brand and track clicks.

personas.name: Tom Wright
personas.bio: Podcast host who wants unlimited links without paying monthly; skeptical of subscriptions.

personas.name: Ana Silva
personas.bio: Beauty consultant who wants clients to book and pay from her bio page; ok paying a little.

personas.name: Leo Novak
personas.bio: Fitness coach who wants a page that collects leads (email or phone) from his profile.

tasks.prompt: Sign up with your email and add your first link to your page.
Find out whether the free plan lets you use unlimited links and what the paid plan adds.
Sign up with your email and get to the page where you edit your links.
Find out whether there is a one-time payment option instead of a monthly subscription.
Sign up with your email and start building your page.
Find out whether you can accept payments or bookings on your page, and on which plan.
